swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV) while TPS63001DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 2 (GND vs SW), Pin 3 (NC vs GND), Pin 4 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 5 (NC vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Soldering TPS63001DRCR onto a TPS613221ADBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-23-5: NONE vs VSON-10: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

CRITICAL TOPOLOGY DIFFERENCE: TPS613221ADBVR is a boost converter whereas TPS63001DRCR is a buck-boost converter; power-stage architecture, inductor placement, and startup behavior differ fundamentally — this is a power-path redesign, not a component swap.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS613221ADBVR specifies 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS63001DRCR 1200 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 305% higher on TPS613221ADBVR (TPS613221ADBVR: 189.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS63001DRCR: 46.8 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS63001DRCR requires Vin,min >= 1.8 V (p.4) vs 0.9 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (TPS613221ADBVR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ) vs TPS63001DRCR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C)); TPS63001DRCR hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS63001DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 2 (GND vs SW), Pin 3 (NC vs GND), Pin 4 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 5 (NC vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 2 (GND vs SW), Pin 3 (NC vs GND), Pin 4 (VOUT vs SW). Power-stage deltas: boost (sync) vs buck-boost (sync), switching frequency 1600 kHz (p.9) vs 1500 kHz (p.5) (1.1x ratio), typical inductor 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.1), output mode fixed vs fixed, and package θJA 189.7 vs 46.8 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS613221ADBVR "No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect" (p.3) and TPS63001DRCR "Pin 10 (FB) MUST Be Connected Directly to VOUT on Fixed 3.3 V TPS63001" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS613221ADBVR when your power stage requires a boost topology or light-load battery standby needs 6.5 µA Iq; choose TPS63001DRCR when your power stage requires a buck-boost topology. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
